chapters.title: Liturgy · Team workspace
chapters.text: Welcome to the Liturgy workspace. This demonstration uses fictional projects and seeded team members, with real local services saving every change we make.

captions.text: Welcome to the Liturgy workspace.
This demonstration uses fictional projects and seeded team members, with real local services saving every change we make.

chapters.title: Begin with the team
chapters.text: The dashboard brings the team and its projects into view. For a Christian team, shared attention begins with people: who we are serving, and what faithful work asks of us today.

captions.text: The dashboard brings the team and its projects into view.
For a Christian team, shared attention begins with people: who we are serving, and what faithful work asks of us today.

chapters.title: Choose a project
chapters.text: Here are the projects in the demonstration workspace. We will follow Lantern, an example project about an after hours crisis line. These are synthetic records, not live service data.

captions.text: Here are the projects in the demonstration workspace.
We will follow Lantern, an example project about an after hours crisis line.
These are synthetic records, not live service data.

chapters.title: The four D journey
chapters.text: Lantern is in Develop. Discover and Discern are already complete in this seeded example. Demonstrate remains behind a gate whose checklist the team can inspect.

captions.text: Lantern is in Develop.
Discover and Discern are already complete in this seeded example.
Demonstrate remains behind a gate whose checklist the team can inspect.

chapters.title: A visible boundary
chapters.text: The outstanding requirement is to prepare a demo for the community. This is a team maintained checklist: the server enforces its recorded state, rather than independently judging the quality of the work.

captions.text: The outstanding requirement is to prepare a demo for the community.
This is a team maintained checklist: the server enforces its recorded state, rather than independently judging the quality of the work.

chapters.title: Develop together
chapters.text: The board brings work items into a shared view. We will open Lantern twenty four and finish the remaining movements in its five R loop.

captions.text: The board brings work items into a shared view.
We will open Lantern twenty four and finish the remaining movements in its five R loop.

chapters.title: Three of five movements complete
chapters.text: This card already has Request, Receive, and Review logged. Mark done is disabled because Render and Rejoice remain. Completion asks us to carry the work through its whole rhythm.

captions.text: This card already has Request, Receive, and Review logged.
Mark done is disabled because Render and Rejoice remain.
Completion asks us to carry the work through its whole rhythm.

chapters.title: Render · Give the work form
chapters.text: Render records the artifact and what changed from the vision. We will describe a synthetic handoff script and the clearer escalation path created for this demonstration.

captions.text: Render records the artifact and what changed from the vision.
We will describe a synthetic handoff script and the clearer escalation path created for this demonstration.

chapters.title: Record the result
chapters.text: The artifact reference and explanation are now entered. These notes help the team connect its earlier discernment with the concrete work it is ready to share.

captions.text: The artifact reference and explanation are now entered.
These notes help the team connect its earlier discernment with the concrete work it is ready to share.

chapters.title: Render recorded
chapters.text: Render has been saved, and Rejoice is now the current movement. The remaining step gives the team a place to name its gratitude before calling the work done.

captions.text: Render has been saved, and Rejoice is now the current movement.
The remaining step gives the team a place to name its gratitude before calling the work done.

chapters.title: Rejoice · Give thanks
chapters.text: We give thanks to God for the people who serve their neighbours and for the care reflected in this example. Thanksgiving is recorded alongside the practical work.

captions.text: We give thanks to God for the people who serve their neighbours and for the care reflected in this example.
Thanksgiving is recorded alongside the practical work.

chapters.title: Five of five movements complete
chapters.text: All five movements are now recorded. Mark done is enabled. The application has verified the loop is complete before offering this final action.

captions.text: All five movements are now recorded.
Mark done is enabled.
The application has verified the loop is complete before offering this final action.

chapters.title: Done, and saved
chapters.text: The card is now in Done, and it remains there after reloading the board. This result comes from the persisted application state.

captions.text: The card is now in Done, and it remains there after reloading the board.
This result comes from the persisted application state.

chapters.title: Prepare to demonstrate
chapters.text: We return to the project journey. With our example walkthrough prepared, we can record the outstanding community demo requirement on the checklist.

captions.text: We return to the project journey.
With our example walkthrough prepared, we can record the outstanding community demo requirement on the checklist.

chapters.title: The checklist gate opens
chapters.text: The gate now shows Open and keeps that state after a reload. This verifies the checklist update was saved; an open gate is distinct from claiming the project has changed phase.

captions.text: The gate now shows Open and keeps that state after a reload.
This verifies the checklist update was saved; an open gate is distinct from claiming the project has changed phase.

chapters.title: A rhythm of faithful work
chapters.text: We have completed a work item and opened a checklist gate through the real application. May our work be shaped by prayer, attentive discernment, service to our neighbours, and thanksgiving.

captions.text: We have completed a work item and opened a checklist gate through the real application.
